name: Denzilore Fatehold
description: A three-faced Echoverse sphinx who founded his school to improve outlook for denizens of Arcavios, surrounded by scrolls showing the past, present and future.

relations.note: Denzilore founded the school and is its dean.
relations.quote: Denzilore Fatehold founded this school to improve the outlook for the denizens of Echoverse Arcavios.

pages_say.description: An elder sphinx who founded the School of Future History to improve the outlook of the denizens of Arcavios.
The Hexhaven school led by Denzilore.
